name: supercreator-raycast
title: Supercreator Admin
description: Quick search for workspaces, creators, and accounts. Impersonate users, copy IDs, and manage account comments.
author: ashley_majar

commands.name: search-accounts
commands.title: Search Accounts & Creators
commands.description: Quick search for workspaces, creators, and accounts by ID, name, email, or workspace UID

commands.name: report-issue
commands.title: Report Issue
commands.description: Report an issue to Rootly with affected accounts and creators

commands.name: feature-request
commands.title: Feature Request
commands.description: Submit a feature request to the R&D team

preferences.name: configBase64
preferences.title: Configuration
preferences.description: Base64-encoded JSON config containing all API keys and database URLs. Create JSON with readDatabaseUrl, writeDatabaseUrl, rootlyApiKey, openaiApiKey and encode with: cat config.json | base64

scripts.lint: echo 'Skipping lint for raycast extension (use fix-lint locally)'
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
